description: This bar chart illustrates performance scores for different models across three metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Metrics,” displays categories: “EGP ↑”, “TR-N ↓”, and “CCP ↑”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Four sets of bars are presented for each metric, representing “Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)” in blue, “RPG (CodeLlama-7B)” in orange, “Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)” in green, and “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” in red. For the “EGP ↑” metric, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.68, the orange bar reaches approximately 0.54, the green bar reaches approximately 0.62, and the red bar reaches approximately 0.44. For the “TR-N ↓” metric, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.64, the orange bar reaches approximately 0.48, the green bar reaches approximately 0.60, and the red bar reaches approximately 0.40. For the “CCP ↑” metric, the blue bar reaches approximately 0.72, the orange bar reaches approximately 0.50, the green bar reaches approximately 0.68, and the red bar reaches approximately 0.42. Within each metric, the bars are grouped by model type, with “Greedy” and “RPG” versions shown side-by-side for both 7B and 34B parameter sizes. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
